candidates.summary: PhoneApplicationService::getCurrentProperty() is a function-static; attached to a Game that is destroyed first (e.g. a Game on main's stack), its destructor runs DetachEXT against a dangling Game* at static destruction. Nothing detaches automatically; no test covers this order.
candidates.note: recorded for the later bug catalogue; not published as a catalogue

candidates.summary: ReadRequestBody's comment says unsupported requests are refused rather than delivered truncated, but a request without Content-Length (including chunked) gets 200 and is dropped, and a body shorter than Content-Length gets 200 and is queued truncated; body size is unbounded.
candidates.note: recorded for the later bug catalogue; not published as a catalogue

candidates.summary: No receive timeout on accepted connections; a stalled peer parks the single listener thread and Close()/the destructor join on it. Source-level; runtime shutdown latency unverified.
candidates.note: recorded for the later bug catalogue; not published as a catalogue

candidates.summary: RawPushNotificationMessage/ToastPushNotificationMessage::SendAsync are documented to return true 'when the receiver accepted it' but return true whenever the request bytes were written; an HTTP 400 still returns true.
candidates.note: recorded for the later bug catalogue; not published as a catalogue

candidates.summary: Toast body concatenates Title/SubTitle into XML without escaping.
candidates.note: recorded for the later bug catalogue; not published as a catalogue

candidates.summary: Duplicate channel names: Open overwrites the registry entry, and the later channel's Close erases the name while the earlier channel is still open, so Find returns null for a live channel.
candidates.note: recorded for the later bug catalogue; not published as a catalogue

candidates.summary: A handler exception during DispatchPendingNotificationsEXT propagates and discards the rest of the already-swapped batch.
candidates.note: recorded for the later bug catalogue; not published as a catalogue

candidates.summary: Windows notification path: no WSAStartup in modules/phone; 'listener < 0' / 'connection < 0' never detect INVALID_SOCKET (unsigned SOCKET); HttpNotificationChannelTests.cpp (with PushNotificationSenderTest) excluded under WIN32, so the Winsock path has no test.
candidates.note: recorded for the later bug catalogue; native Windows behaviour unverified

candidates.summary: Channel and sender sockets send with flags 0 and set no SO_NOSIGPIPE, unlike the Inspector socket layer; SIGPIPE exposure against a resetting peer is unverified.
candidates.note: recorded for the later bug catalogue; not published as a catalogue

candidates.summary: Concurrency: listenSocket_ is a plain int read by the worker and reset by Close (formal data race); Open's listening_ check is not a compare-exchange; a persistent accept() error busy-loops without backoff.
candidates.note: recorded for the later bug catalogue; not published as a catalogue

candidates.summary: CNA's docs/physical-modules.md lists phone's Sharp Runtime components as Core.Base, Collections.Core; modules/phone/CMakeLists.txt also links Uri.
candidates.note: CNA documentation drift, not a code defect

candidates.summary: HeadlessWindow accepts WindowDescription::fullscreenMode = BorderlessFullscreen at creation although the platform reports borderlessFullscreen=false and SetFullscreenMode refuses it; the conformance case only covers the setter.
candidates.note: recorded for the later bug catalogue; not published as a catalogue

candidates.note: recorded for the later bug catalogue; not published as a catalogue

candidates.summary: HeadlessPlatform::InjectEvent has no caller anywhere in the TARGET tree.

candidates.summary: No CMake or CTest test exercises the reserved-identifier refusal path (SDL12, EMSCRIPTEN, WIN32 off Windows, TERMINAL on Windows).
candidates.evidence: cmake/PlatformSelection.cmake; cmake/Tests/ (only WaylandPlatformSelection.cmake covers selection, for Wayland)
candidates.note: recorded for the later bug catalogue; not published as a catalogue

candidates.summary: CNA's own docs/platform-abstraction.md 'Implementations' table lists five backends and omits X11 and WAYLAND.

candidates.summary: The selection files do not exclude HEADLESS, TERMINAL or SDL2 on macOS/Emscripten, nor X11 on macOS, so unvalidated combinations are offered by CMake.

candidates.summary: The SDL2-only configure guard lists VULKAN among recommended SDL-independent renderers, but the SDL2 platform has no Vulkan surface service, so a VULKAN build on SDL2 can only fail at renderer construction.
candidates.note: source reading only, not executed; stated on the page as a maintainer note

candidates.summary: Sdl2OnlyConfiguration.cmake checks only CNA_GRAPHICS_RENDERER, not the CNA_GRAPHICS_RENDERERS multi-renderer list; no other gate for SDL2 plus an SDL3-linked family in that list was found in cmake/Renderer*.cmake.
candidates.note: possible gap, unconfirmed by a configure run; recorded here only, not published

candidates.summary: SDL2 negates flipped wheel deltas while SDL3 passes SDL's adjusted values through, so the two backends can report opposite wheel signs under natural scrolling.
candidates.note: inferred from source; not observed on a host; stated on the page with that hedge

candidates.summary: Source comments in Sdl3Platform.cpp and X11Platform.cpp refer to Game::UpdateInput(), which does not exist; the controller-pump gate is in Game::PollEvents.
candidates.note: recorded for the later bug catalogue; not published as a catalogue (stated on the page as a maintainer note)

candidates.summary: Reading SDL3 capabilities starts SDL_INIT_CAMERA for the process lifetime (outside ownedRefCounts_) wherever SDL has a camera driver; deliberate per the source, but it means a capability query has side effects.
candidates.note: design note, not asserted to be a defect

candidates.summary: Game's IsMouseVisible setter forwards to IPlatformMouse::SetCursorVisible when a platform window exists; TerminalMouse::SetCursorVisible always throws PlatformException, and the Game comment still calls the terminal mouse null. A game changing IsMouseVisible on a queryable terminal would get an exception (by reading; not executed).
candidates.note: recorded for the later bug catalogue; not published as a catalogue

candidates.summary: Window title is stored but never emitted: SetTitle's comment defers OSC emission to the session, but BuildSessionPrologue has no title sequence.

candidates.summary: SIGTSTP/SIGCONT are not in TerminalSession's restoring signal set; an externally stopped process leaves the terminal in session state until continued.

candidates.summary: TerminalPlatform::queued_ is appended to every PollEvents but nothing ever fills it (dead state).

candidates.summary: No GitHub workflow selects CNA_PLATFORM=WAYLAND; the backend's suites are launched only locally through tools/platform/wayland_test_server.sh.

candidates.summary: The CnaPlatformWindow.Owned window property is written and removed but never read; its comment claims AdoptWindowHandle refuses an owned HWND, while the code returns a borrowed wrapper sharing the owner's id (and a test asserts that).
candidates.note: comment/code drift; recorded for the later bug catalogue; not published as a catalogue

candidates.summary: A foreign HWND adopted by handle is not subclassed (no CNA events) and is absent from windows_, so WGL CreateContext, Vulkan CreateSurface, relative-mouse targeting and Win32TextInput::Start refuse its id; no test covers foreign-HWND adoption with these services.
candidates.note: source reading, not executed; recorded for the later bug catalogue

candidates.summary: EnterExclusiveFullscreen returns silently when monitor info, EnumDisplaySettingsW or ChangeDisplaySettingsExW fails although its comment says a refusal is reported; GetFullscreenMode then reports ExclusiveFullscreen. The mode change requests the monitor's current size.
candidates.note: source reading, not executed

candidates.summary: Win32GlContext ignores GlContextDescription multisample fields and per-channel sizes and WindowDescription::renderIntent/openGlFramebuffer; when wglCreateContextAttribsARB is absent or fails the legacy bootstrap context is returned while GetContextAttributes reports the requested description.
candidates.note: source reading, not executed

candidates.summary: Minor comment drift: Win32DirectXIntegrationTests.cpp cites spikes/win32-directx-spike/ (absent; spikes/win32-spike exists); Win32Common.hpp's comment says 'Windows 10 1703' while defining 0x0603.
candidates.note: not published on the page

candidates.summary: X11Platform.hpp documents that every Xlib call goes through one per-instance mutex, but no such mutex exists; X11Display.hpp likewise says the connection opens on first Video acquisition and closes on last release, while the code opens it in the constructor and closes it in the destructor. Header comments contradict the implementation.
candidates.note: recorded for the later bug catalogue; not published as a catalogue

candidates.summary: Several X11Platform.hpp accessor comments say services are 'null before Video', but services are created with the constructor's connection and are non-null whenever the connection succeeded; AcquireSubsystem's @throws PlatformNotSupportedException is never thrown.
candidates.note: documentation drift inside the source; recorded for the later bug catalogue

candidates.summary: Stale comments in X11Platform.cpp (and Sdl3Platform.cpp) refer to Game::UpdateInput(), which does not exist; snapshot updates happen at the end of Game::PollEvents.
candidates.note: comment drift; recorded for the later bug catalogue

candidates.summary: CNA_X11_HAVE_VULKAN_HEADERS is defined by cmake/PlatformX11.cmake but consumed by no source; the dependency summary therefore implies a Vulkan-header gate that does not exist.
